translation:
When the interior is harmonious and there is disease in the exterior (one version: yang vacuous, yin exuberant),

sweating it cures it, while purging it kills. If this is so, then the Spirit Elixir (Shendan) cannot be wrongly released (the Shendan Pill is the one of six ingredients in the Cui family section of this volume), and how can Gansui (Euphorbia) be recklessly attacked? (Gansui is the Water-Guiding Powder, the one of two ingredients such as Gansui in the third volume, in the section on epidemic mania; it comes from the Qianjin Fang.) The treatment of exterior and interior, going against each other by a thousand li, the mechanism of good and ill fortune responds like shadow and echo.
